errors.title: Cluster unreachable or terminated
causes: cluster terminated mid-run (idle timeout, spot loss)

errors.title: Unity Catalog permission denied
causes: principal lacks USE CATALOG/SELECT on the UC object
storage credential or external location misconfigured

errors.title: Spark Connect/gRPC failure
causes: client/server version skew on the Spark Connect channel
network path blocked between client and cluster

errors.title: Notebook/library install failure
causes: incompatible wheel/index for the DBR version
init script wrote to a path the runtime cannot read
